content: Furthermore, recent financial growth highlights that the market expanded from 50.54 billion in 2025 to 53.76 billion in 2026 [1] . Other analyses suggest the global sector reached a valuation of 59.8 billion in 2026 [4] , with alternative estimates placing the 2026 value at USD 59.36 billion and forecasting substantial growth to USD 85.78 billion by 2033 at a compound annual growth rate of 5.4 percent [3] . Additional projections indicate the global market could reach 67.95 billion by 2030, driven by a compound annual growth rate of 6 percent [5] . In terms of volume, the worldwide market for crane rentals was estimated at 391,000 units in 2025 and is expected to grow to 784,767 units by 2035, with growth between 2026 and 2035 indicating continuous industry expansion [2] . While these macroeconomic indicators underscore a strong global outlook, they also highlight a critical gap in region-focused research specifically detailing the localized participants within the South African sector. Financially, the broader global and regional crane markets have seen substantial valuation increases. Earlier market estimations projected that the broader industry valuation would reach 67.95 billion dollars by 2026, representing a notable increase from a previous valuation of 53.76 billion dollars, expanding at a compound annual growth rate of approximately 6 percent [24][25] .
